meta.title: DottyPic: Free Aesthetic Photo Editor for Everyone
meta.description: DottyPic is a free aesthetic photo editor with small, easy tools for quote posts, overlays, and patterned backgrounds. No skills needed, no watermark, no sign up.

hero.headline: Free Aesthetic Photo Editor for <swash>Everyone</swash>
hero.subheadline: Small, easy tools that turn any photo into something you would actually post. No layers, no learning curve, nothing to install.
hero.badge: Free · No watermark · No sign up

toolGrid.heading: Meet the free online aesthetic photo edit tools
toolGrid.lead: Each tool does one thing and takes about a minute to work out. Simple enough if you have never edited a photo, quick enough that designers use them to skip opening anything heavier.

cards.momentCard: Your words get their own color block instead of sitting on top of the photo.
cards.dot: Scatter snowflakes, hearts, or stars across your photo, colored to match it.
cards.polkaDot: Polka dot backgrounds in any size, spacing, and color. The one that started all this.
cards.geometricPatterns: Waves, grids, triangles, terrazzo. Backgrounds for posts, slides, or wallpapers.

more.heading: More on the way
more.body: New tools land here as we build them. Same free, no watermark, no sign up.

colorEngine.heading: Automatic color matching, straight from your photo
colorEngine.body: Every tool reads your photo, pulls out its main tones, and builds from those. The text block, the overlay shapes, the background pattern, all of it already matches before you touch anything. You can still change any of it. Most people never need to.

art.heading: Every color comes from your photo
art.subheading: Upload once. The palette, the text block, and every pattern match automatically.
art.tagline: Free · No watermark · No sign up

free.heading: Free, and not the kind that runs out
free.body: Every tool, every shape, and every export size is free right now and will stay that way. There is no premium tier keeping the better options out of reach, no credits to buy, and no fourteen day clock quietly counting down while you work. What you can make today is what you will still be able to make next month.

noWatermark.heading: Nothing stamped on your work, ever
noWatermark.body: No logo in the corner, no faint diagonal text across the middle, and nothing baked into the file that announces which tool you used. You will never reach the download button and find out that removing a mark costs money. The image you export is the image you made, and it is yours to post anywhere you like.

unlimited.heading: Make as many as you want
unlimited.body: No daily cap, no export counter ticking down in the corner, and no queue when the site is busy. Try ten versions of the same photo and keep the one you like. Nothing here is metered, so there is no reason to be careful about how much you use it.

noAccount.heading: No account, no email, no waiting
noAccount.body: There is no sign up screen standing between you and the tools. No password to invent, no verification link to dig out of your spam folder, and no newsletter box already ticked on your behalf. Open a page and it is working. If you want to make one image and never come back, that is completely fine.

mira.quote: I have zero design skills and I make all my Instagram posts here now. The color matching is what sold me. I never have to guess which shade goes with what.
mira.name: Mira K.

dan.quote: Used the overlay editor for a winter campaign mockup. Faster than building the same thing in Illustrator, and it honestly looked better.
dan.name: Dan R.

kenji.quote: I needed a polka dot background for a slide deck and did not want to make an account anywhere. Took about two minutes start to finish.
kenji.name: Kenji S.

priya.quote: The no watermark thing is why I stayed. Every other free editor puts a logo on your work and then asks you to pay to take it off.
priya.name: Priya N.

free.question: Is DottyPic free?
free.answer: Yes, completely. Every tool, every shape, and every export size is free. There is no paid tier and no trial that runs out on you.

watermark.question: Do you add a watermark to my image?
watermark.answer: No. Anything you export comes out clean, with no DottyPic logo anywhere on it. You can post it or use it however you want.

account.question: Do I need an account to use DottyPic?
account.answer: No. There is no sign up and no email required. Open any tool on the site and you can start working straight away.

experience.question: Do I need any editing experience?
experience.answer: No. DottyPic was built for people who have never edited a photo. There are no layers, no masks, and no color picker you have to get right. Upload something, move a slider or two if you feel like it, and download.

audience.question: Is DottyPic for designers or for beginners?
audience.answer: Both, but mostly beginners. Most people here just want a post that looks put together without opening Photoshop. Designers use it too, usually to grab a quick background or overlay instead of building one from scratch.

whatToMake.question: What can I make with DottyPic?
whatToMake.answer: Quote posts with a matching color block, photos with snowflake or heart overlays, polka dot backgrounds, and geometric patterns. People use them for Instagram posts and stories, slide decks, phone wallpapers, and small business graphics.

sizes.question: What sizes can I export?
sizes.answer: Instagram posts and stories, 16:9 slides, phone wallpapers, and custom dimensions. Everything exports as PNG, with a 2x option when you need it sharper.

commercial.question: Can I use what I make commercially?
commercial.answer: Yes. Anything you make with DottyPic is yours to use, including for client work and for products you sell. The only thing you cannot do is resell the tools themselves.

finalCta.heading: Go make something
finalCta.body: Pick a tool, drop in a photo, see what comes out. Free, no watermark, no sign up.

faqPage.heading: FAQ
faqPage.lead: Everything you need to know about Dottypic.

free.question: Is Dottypic's dot image generator free to use?
free.answer: Yes! You get full access to our Automatic Photo Collage Maker and all design elements for free. Best of all? No watermarks on your final masterpieces.

registration.question: Do I need to register to use the dot image generator?
registration.answer: No registration required! We believe in "creating on the go." Just upload, edit your polka dot pattern, and download. Simple as that.

density.question: Can I customize the density of the polka dot pattern?
density.answer: Absolutely. You have full control over the polka dots pattern. You can adjust the shape, size, color, and spacing to create a look that is uniquely yours.

shapes.question: Can I change the dots to other shapes?
shapes.answer: Of course! While we love a classic polka dot setting, you can switch to hearts, stars, or waterdrops to match your specific vibe.

autoAnalyze.question: How does the "Auto-Analyze" feature work?
autoAnalyze.answer: Our smart tool "reads" the dominant colors in your uploaded images and automatically suggests a dot pattern and background color that complements your photo perfectly. It's like having a tiny designer in your pocket!

ownBackground.question: Can I use my own background images?
ownBackground.answer: Yes! You can use our AI-generated colors or upload your own favorite textures and patterns to use as a base for your collage.

mobile.question: Will the dot image generator work on my phone?
mobile.answer: Yes! Dottypic is optimized for mobile and desktop browsers, so you can create aesthetic collages whenever inspiration strikes.

privacy.question: How does the Automatic Photo Collage Maker handle my privacy?
privacy.answer: Your photos stay yours. Dottypic processes everything locally in your browser. We never store or upload your images to a server, ensuring 100% privacy and security.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: Learn how Dottypic handles your data and privacy.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Dottypic ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information when you use our browser-based photo decoration tool.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: We do not collect personal data. Dottypic is designed to work entirely in your browser. Photos you upload are processed locally on your device — they are never sent to our servers.

processing.title: Photo Processing
processing.content: All photo editing, texture rendering, and dot generation happens in your browser using client-side JavaScript. Your images do not leave your device at any point during the decoration or export process.

cookies.title: Cookies & Local Storage
cookies.content: We may use browser local storage to save your editor preferences between sessions (such as your last selected paper or dot settings). We also use Google Analytics to collect anonymous usage statistics (such as page views and session duration) to help us improve the service. Google Analytics may use cookies to collect this data. No personally identifiable information is collected.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Dottypic does not share any data with third-party services. There are no embedded advertising networks or external analytics platforms in our application.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: Since we do not collect or store personal data, there is nothing to access, modify, or delete. If you have any concerns about your privacy while using Dottypic, please contact us.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated revision date.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out at <mail>support@dottypic.com</mail>.

description.content: Dottypic is a free, browser-based photo decoration tool. You upload a photo, apply a paper texture, configure dot patterns, and download the result as a PNG. All processing occurs locally in your browser — no server upload is required.

warranties.content: Dottypic is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or compatible with all devices.
